t.zh: 六种元件都有了：分解、删除、冲突、消元、定向、出现检查。这一回每一种都可能用到，用几次、何时用，由等式决定。设计出的证明助手会成为新元件「合一器」。
t.en: All six kinds of part are in hand: Decompose, Delete, Conflict, Eliminate, Orient, Occurs check. This time any of them may be needed, how often and when depending on the equations. The proof assistant you design becomes a new part, “Unifier”.

after.zh: 合一器求出的是<wiki-ref to="mgu"></wiki-ref>：只确定非确定不可的部分。
after.en: What the unifier finds is the <wiki-ref to="mgu"></wiki-ref>: it settles only what must be settled.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：不管要拆几层、代几次，都把等式解到底；对不上或者没有解的，说「失败」。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that solves any set of equations to the end, however many levels and substitutions it takes, or says “failed” when they do not fit or have no solution.

hint.zh: 每种元件都要进重复框。
hint.en: Every kind of part belongs in the repeat frame.
